시편 143:1.content: A Psalm of David. Hear my prayer, O Lord, give ear to my supplications: in thy faithfulness answer me, and in thy righteousness.

시편 143:2.content: And enter not into judgment with thy servant: for in thy sight shall no man living be justified.

시편 143:3.content: For the enemy hath persecuted my soul; he hath smitten my life down to the ground; he hath made me to dwell in darkness, as those that have been long dead.

시편 143:4.content: Therefore is my spirit overwhelmed within me; my heart within me is desolate.

시편 143:5.content: I remember the days of old; I meditate on all thy works; I muse on the work of thy hands.

시편 143:6.content: I stretch forth my hands unto thee: my soul thirsteth after thee, as a thirsty land. Selah.

시편 143:7.content: Hear me speedily, O Lord: my spirit faileth: hide not thy face from me, lest I be like unto them that go down into the pit.

시편 143:8.content: Cause me to hear thy lovingkindness in the morning; for in thee do I trust: cause me to know the way wherein I should walk; for I lift up my soul unto thee.

시편 143:9.content: Deliver me, O Lord, from mine enemies: I flee unto thee to hide me.

시편 143:10.content: Teach me to do thy will; for thou art my God: thy spirit is good; lead me into the land of uprightness.

시편 143:11.content: Quicken me, O Lord, for thy name’s sake: for thy righteousness’ sake bring my soul out of trouble.

시편 143:12.content: And of thy mercy cut off mine enemies, and destroy all them that afflict my soul: for I am thy servant.
